changes.summary: After installing the exact published package, registered upgrade refreshes compiled authority and framework identities to 2.6.4. Native Vitest report custody retains complete raw streams; unrelated tracked internal directory links are bound only as opaque metadata under ADR-SCR-0021. Actual alias reads remain refused. Already validated repository-relative native configuration is executed through its canonical absolute argument, bound with its bytes and preparation in the selection identity; external, linked and swapped configuration remains refused. Collection, nonce, candidate, task and execution-origin verification are preserved. This repair adds no adopter configuration, public action or new evidence standing. Existing constitution, authority roots, declared inputs, thresholds and trusted verifier remain unchanged.

Constitution 1.1.0 amends Articles 6, 7 and 10 so the Engineer holds a focused-regression verb on the test class: within a task that changes sources it may add tests that import or target a file the same task changed and modify tests that task added, never delete a test, change another test's assertions, or lower a threshold; a round or task designated independent-assurance withholds the verb. Every other core path row is unchanged. Binding it replaces the vendored copy and the project.json pin.

obligations.requirement: Bind the installed constitution with init upgrade --constitution (or init bind --constitution) after the Architect has reviewed the amendment.
